purpose: Define a falsifiable, information-bounded path from the GEN-LEARNING-01 static capability baseline to simulation, pilot calibration, and only then a separately authorized human-learning trial.

secondaryOutcomes: time, setup, context, mutation, cleanup, and account-boundary cost

phaseOrder.purpose: Exercise identity, authority, route, oracle, exposure, measurement, cleanup, and claim gates with synthetic records only.
phaseOrder.exit: All positive and negative fixtures match preregistered outcomes; no model, candidate, account, or participant surface is touched.

phaseOrder.purpose: Build and independently review one synthetic micro-domain public packet, private oracle, misconception map, assessment forms, and cleanup manifest.
phaseOrder.exit: Public information equivalence, private-oracle isolation, scoring determinism, accessibility review, and no-prior-knowledge assumptions are challenged.

phaseOrder.purpose: Use the smallest separately authorized pilot to validate treatment delivery, host capture, timing, isolation, and cleanup without an efficacy claim.
phaseOrder.exit: Exact treatment and route receipts, evaluator independence, participant-data handling, and cleanup are complete; pilot limitations remain explicit.

phaseOrder.purpose: Run a separately authorized, powered, randomized between-subject trial only after the preceding gates pass.
phaseOrder.exit: Independent analysis reports effect estimates, uncertainty, attrition, protocol deviations, cost, adverse outcomes, and non-results without automatic admission or standards promotion.

fixtureDesign.contentClass: novel synthetic micro-domain with fixed rules and no required personal, educational, employment, or identity data
publicPacket: worked examples shared identically across arms
practice item pool without assessment answers
fixtureDesign.informationEquivalence: All treatment arms receive the same public packet and task budget. External browsing, unbound source retrieval, hidden prior conversation, private-oracle access, and treatment-specific answer leakage invalidate the run.
fixtureDesign.contaminationBoundary: Use randomized between-subject allocation stratified by pretest. Do not expose one learner to multiple arms on the same micro-domain and do not reuse assessment items as practice.
fixtureDesign.delayedWindow: seven days plus or minus one day, fixed before recruitment
fixtureDesign.sampleSizeBoundary: No efficacy sample size is invented by this protocol; determine it from a preregistered estimand, pilot variance or defensible prior evidence, attrition allowance, and power analysis before formal execution.

arms.treatment: Codex native behavior with all configurable user Skills disabled and no MCP, App, Plugin, or additional learning structure.
arms.attributionBoundary: Baseline for the exact Codex host and model route only.

arms.treatment: Exact pinned Matt teach content selected explicitly as the only configurable user Skill in a disposable isolated workspace.
requiredExposureEvidence: exact source pin and file manifest
instruction-delivery evidence distinct from installation or projection
all other configurable user Skills disabled
before-and-after workspace manifest and cleanup receipt
arms.attributionBoundary: Only the same-host native-versus-teach pair can support a bounded selected-treatment comparison, and only after delivery is proved.

arms.treatment: Exactly one separately selected official learning mode on its documented host and account boundary.
arms.attributionBoundary: This is a product-bundle arm. It cannot be pooled across providers or used to attribute an effect solely to learning-mode instructions, model, or host.

arms.treatment: A human instructor or mentor uses the same public packet and task budget without AI assistance.
arms.authorityBoundary: The instructor retains judgment, accommodation, and safeguarding authority but cannot see the private assessment oracle during tutoring.
arms.attributionBoundary: Human-control quality and protocol adherence must be observed rather than assumed.

measurementContract.pretest: Record prior competence before allocation; do not treat self-report alone as baseline competence.
measurementContract.immediateIndependentAssessment: Unaided assessment after treatment, separate from practice and completion artifacts.
measurementContract.delayedUnaidedAssessment: Parallel-form assessment in the fixed delayed window with no treatment access.
measurementContract.novelTransferTask: New surface form and task context requiring the same underlying rules without copying a worked example.
measurementContract.misconceptionOracle: Score whether predeclared misconceptions persist, are corrected, or are replaced by new errors.
measurementContract.learnerAutonomy: Observe unassisted planning, explanation, error detection, calibrated help-seeking, and dependency signals.
measurementContract.accessibility: Record barriers, accommodation use, and differential task loss without treating disability or identity as a performance defect.
measurementContract.teacherReview: An evaluator distinct from the tutor reviews reasoning traces, misconceptions, accessibility, and unsafe or misleading instruction.
measurementContract.lifecycleCost: Record setup, account, time, context, files, external calls, mutation, cleanup, evaluator, and participant burden per arm.
measurementContract.nonCancellation: Immediate correctness cannot cancel worse delayed competence, transfer, autonomy, accessibility, adverse outcomes, authority violations, or incomplete cleanup.

analysisBoundary.primaryEstimand: Between-arm difference in delayed unaided competence adjusted by preregistered baseline competence.
analysisBoundary.sameHostSelectedTreatmentEstimand: Native Codex Spark/low versus exact Matt teach on the same host, route, public packet, and budget; delivery failure invalidates the pair.
analysisBoundary.officialArmEstimand: Whole selected product-bundle effect relative to the preregistered comparator, not a cross-provider or mode-only causal effect.
reporting: raw arm-level outcome and cost summaries
adverse dependency, accessibility, privacy, or authority outcomes

participant consent, privacy, retention, withdrawal, and safeguarding boundary
separate authority for model dispatch, Matt candidate execution, official account access, and human-participant trial
visible actual weak-model route equal to gpt-5.3-codex-spark with low reasoning
exact Matt teach exposure and instruction-delivery preflight
one explicit official product selection without provider pooling
isolated disposable workspace and exact cleanup procedure
independent evaluator identity and blind scoring where feasible

nextGate.nextAction: Create one synthetic micro-domain public packet, private oracle, misconception map, parallel assessments, transfer task, accessibility checklist, and cleanup manifest; validate them offline before seeking any live authority.
